summaryZh: Cool Star Lab 首页近期项目涉及用 JWST 研究低温棕矮星的大气分子，以及利用光谱识别冷星和发现棕矮星。当前捕获主要是项目新闻，不能视为全实验室研究范围的完整概述。

evidence.quote: UC San Diego Cool Star Lab
the team's work on biosignature molecules in the atmospheres of low-temperature brown dwarfs with JWST

Vivian presented the spectra of several dozen previously unclassified cool stars found in the IRTF SpeX Archive , while Marylin presented new distant brown dwarf discoveries in deep JWST spectroscopy.
